282 likes, 34 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 22, 2026: "Delhi mein sasta speaker chahiye? Lajpat Rai Market jao 🔊 Save karo, shopping pe jaate waqt kaam aayega 📌

Chandni Chowk ke is speaker market mein chhote bluetooth speaker se lekar bade DJ setup tak sab kuch milta hai, wholesale rate pe.

Tip: 2-3 dukaanon pe rate poochh ke hi lena, aur bill zaroor lena. Nearest metro Chandni Chowk hai.

#lajpatraimarket #chandnichowk #delhimarkets #speakermarket #delhitravelblogger".
